semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Sensortherm provides precise non-contact temperature measurement solutions critical for semiconductor fabrication processes.
summary: Sensortherm specializes in digital pyrometer technology, offering advanced infrared measuring instruments for the semiconductor industry. Their products are essential for accurate temperature monitoring and control during fabrication processes, ensuring high-quality production outcomes.
capabilities: Digital pyrometers with advanced signal processing
Ratio pyrometers for fast temperature measurement
Infrared system components for process monitoring
Calibration lamps for temperature measurement accuracy

regional_presence.Germany: Manufactures all products at their facility in Steinbach, Germany.
